now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16
now.text: After Yo-Yo loses her arms, Fitz builds her new ones. When Mack locks Fitz in a cell, she is the one who frees him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who builds Yo-Yo new arms. She frees him from Mack's cell.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Fitz builds new arms for, who frees him from Mack's cell.

proposed.text: Wearing the new arms Fitz built her, Yo-Yo helps Simmons trick Mack into letting Fitz out of his cell, then locks Mack in it and leaves with the pair to hunt Hydra's weapon.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who builds Yo-Yo new arms. She helps break him out of his cell.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Fitz builds new arms for, who helps break him out of his cell.

changes.evidence: Inside Voices (S5#16): Fitz is already confined after The Doctor episode; Mack, left in charge, refuses to release him. Simmons fakes being poisoned so Mack lets Fitz out, and Yo-Yo then uses her speed to lock Mack in the cell. Mack does not lock Fitz up, and Yo-Yo does not free him alone (it is Simmons' scheme). The arms were built earlier (S5#12-15).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#17
now.text: Hale opens fire on the team and shoots Deke in the chest, nearly killing him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The general who hunts Deke as a suspected LMD, then shoots him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A suspect Hale tracks as an LMD, then shoots in the chest.

proposed.text: When Deke stays behind to back up Daisy against Ruby, Hale arrives with her Mechs and shoots him in the shoulder, nearly killing him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A suspect Hale tracks as an LMD, then shoots in the shoulder.

changes.evidence: The Honeymoon (S5#17): Deke steps out to take Ruby's chakram and is shot in the right shoulder by Hale, who has just arrived with Sleeper Mechs; he ends up in critical condition. Both the episode page and Deke's page say shoulder, not chest.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18
now.text: Hale secretly leads Hydra and plans to turn Quake into a weapon with Gravitonium, but when her daughter Ruby spins out of control, Hale surrenders to Daisy and helps her storm the Hydra base.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A general who secretly leads Hydra, then surrenders to Daisy.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hale blames her for Talbot and plans to weaponize her, then turns to her for help.

proposed.text: When Daisy and May raid the Hydra Academy, Hale surrenders at once and asks for help stopping Ruby. At the facility she and Daisy try to calm Ruby, who has lost control of the Gravitonium.

changes.evidence: All Roads Lead... (S5#18): Hale surrenders immediately when Quake and May attack the Academy, before Ruby is infused, and takes them to the Herefordshire facility; only then does Ruby lose control, and Hale and Quake try to calm her. She does not surrender because Ruby spins out of control, and she does not help storm a Hydra base. Her plan to make Daisy the weapon is from Rise and Shine (S5#15).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#19
now.text: Talbot infuses himself with Gravitonium and becomes a threat to the whole planet, and May's team has to stop him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Agent whose team has to stop Talbot after Gravitonium.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Turns into a threat to the planet with Gravitonium. May's team must stop him.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#20
proposed.text: When May and Daisy board Qovas' ship to bring Coulson back, Talbot, now powered by gravitonium, knocks Daisy out and forces May to surrender.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Talbot forces to surrender aboard Qovas' ship.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Gravitonium-powered general who forces May to surrender aboard Qovas' ship.

changes.evidence: Option Two (S5#19): Talbot takes in the gravitonium and crushes the Remorath, saving May and the others in the control room, then leaves with Coulson; nothing there makes him a threat to the planet or sets May's team to stop him (his Chicago attack is S5#21-22, so the current text and cards also run ahead). The One Who Will Save Us All (S5#20) is where he turns on them: Quake and May reach him on Qovas' ship, he threatens Coulson, knocks Quake out and forces May to surrender. Moving there fits the enemy kind.
